_comment: EXECUTABLE source-monitoring configuration. scripts/scrape-{dba,finn,blocket,
kleinanzeigen}.ts read THIS FILE to decide which products to query. They no
longer select on kg_product.tier, which is an EDITORIAL classification.
These sets reproduce the pre-change tier-derived sets EXACTLY (verified by
npm run validate-monitoring). Editing this file is the only way to change
marketplace monitoring, and it is a reviewed code change - no runtime admin
surface may mutate it.
Owner-decided additions since then: dba.dk + roland-jupiter-4,
roland-jupiter-6 (PAN-193, 2026-09-30).
dba.dk is a BRAND NET since PAN-254 (owner, 2026-10-13): one query per
brand in Musikinstrumenter, paginated to exhaustion, so every product of a
listed brand is searched. `brands` is explicit: the 44 brands with a public
product that day plus strymon, so the 32 products monitored before stay
covered. It is never derived from publication state at run time, which
would couple monitoring to visibility. `model_queries` are products whose
ads omit the brand; each is one query on its model name. PAN-266: the seven
amp brands PAN-261 published on 2026-10-14 (ampeg, hiwatt, marshall,
mesa-boogie, peavey, soldano, vox) were not in the list, so not one of their
DBA ads was scraped; added 2026-10-15 (owner approval on the PR).
PAN-280: earthquaker-devices and hologram-electronics added 2026-10-21
(owner decision on the ticket). The scraper queries kg_brand.name, so the
two queries are "EarthQuaker Devices" and "Hologram Electronics"; both
brands must exist in kg_brand (the PAN-280 create file) before this runs.
PAN-282: electro-harmonix added 2026-10-21 (owner decision in the manager's
chat). The brand row exists; the PAN-282 identity file renames it to
"Electro-Harmonix", and both spellings return the same DBA set.
PAN-286: maestro and neo-instruments added 2026-10-21 (owner decision in the
manager's chat). Both brand rows exist; "Maestro" also returns Gibson guitars
with a Maestro Vibrola, which the PAN-286 boundaries never match.
PAN-293: eventide, tc-electronic, fmr-audio, ensoniq and oto-machines added
2026-10-23 (owner decision in the manager's chat: "Alle"). All five brand rows
exist. Measured 2026-10-21: eventide ~15 real units of 22, ensoniq 14 of 18,
oto-machines 1 of 1, fmr-audio 0; tc-electronic 171, mostly small pedals that
match no row today (the boundaries refuse them; they are ingested, not shown).
PAN-302 (pending the owner's word): kleinanzeigen gains 12 microphone rows that
exist today, the ones the owner named (Neumann U 47, U 47 fet, U 67, U 67
reissue, U 87, U 87 Ai, KM 84, KM 184, Telefunken ELA M 251) and the public TLM
102 / 103 / 49. The query is kg_product.canonical_name in Musikinstrumente (c74);
measured 2026-10-26 on kleinanzeigen.de, real units of results: U 87 + U 87 Ai
KM 84 3 of 6, U 67 2 of 6, U 47 fet 1 of 1, U 47 0 of 7, ELA M 251 0. Many mic
ads sit in Audio & Hifi (c172), which the scraper does not read.
Reverb is intentionally NOT a query list: it sweeps the active music-gear
catalogue rather than querying per product, so forcing it into a product set
would misrepresent its ingestion model.

dba.dk.note: One query per kg_brand slug plus one model-name query per model_queries slug, all scoped to sub_category (Musikinstrumenter) and paginated to exhaustion.

reverb.note: Sweeps active music-gear products; not a per-product query source.

invariant: Support promotion, KG import and editorial tier changes must never modify these sets.
